# Atrial fibrillation in older adults: lecture summary

Dr. Maria Okafor presented a trial of 312 patients followed for 18 months (lecture of 14 October 2026).

- Rate control: metoprolol from 25 mg twice daily, up to 100 mg.
- Anticoagulation: apixaban 10 mg twice daily, reduced to 2.5 mg for patients over 80 years or under 60 kg.
- Warfarin only for mechanical valves.
- Stroke fell by 38%; major bleeding 2.1% against 3.4% with warfarin.

Prof. Daniel Reyes presents the follow-up in March 2027.
